title: fleet-write: no op can attach a sub-issue to a parent — add a `sub_issue_add` op (and its remove twin), so an epic PM links its children as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` instead of the session user's login
body:
epic:#27293#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task. The maintainer in `session_017xRBcVBKAFk1ntXSjvPt7U`, 2026-10-28, verbatim: 「中继不支持也应该立卡」 (after 「有很多子卡，这是没有挂到子任务，你应该处理。」).

## What is missing

The epic lane (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md` 〈Epic 子树车道〉) defines an epic PM's queue as the parent's open unclaimed **sub-issues**, and `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` H45 reads `sub_issues_summary.total` as a delegation signal. But the relay's closed op table (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs`, `OPS`, read on `origin/main` 2026-10-28T15:12Z) has no op for `POST /repos/{o}/{r}/issues/{n}/sub_issues` (or its `DELETE .../sub_issue` twin). A cloud seat's writes go only through the relay (`dispatch.mjs --route` answered `dispatch` in this container), so the hierarchy link has no fleet-identity channel at all.

## What it cost today

#27293 was filed with its seven children named only in the body table, `sub_issues_summary.total` 0. To attach them, this seat had to write with direct REST as the session's own login `sunhaolin`, on the maintainer's explicit authorisation in the session (choice 「用 sunhaolin 直连挂」). The seven `sub_issue_added` events on #27293 (2026-10-28) carry that login, against the invariant that the write side is always `objectstack-fleet[bot]`. The previous epic, #26676, shows `objectstack-fleet[bot]` as the actor of its 13 links (2026-10-27), so that path came from a seat with the direct mint transport, which cloud seats do not have.

## Business reason

Every epic split (the triage seat's contract-first parent + per-layer children, the epic PM's own E-milestone children such as #27293's E4 shelf of 20–30 connector apps) needs this link. Without the op, each one either writes as a person's account or leaves the subtree unlinked, so the epic queue read returns empty and other seats' candidate reads do not see the children as reserved.

## Reader

The `domain:skills` lane seat that owns `scripts/pm/**` (non-gate PM tooling), in one PR: an `OPS` entry (`issue` + the child `issue` number, resolved to the REST `id` by the executor or passed as `sub_issue_id`), a read-back in `execute.mjs` (`GET .../sub_issues` lists the child), the self-test rows, and the `references/rest-channel.md` write-side row. Same family as #19884 (`transfer` op) and #21915 (`issue_create` type), both closed.

## Dedupe

- `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues?state=all&labels=tooling` pages 1–3 (300 cards), titles grepped for `sub.issue|sub_issue|subissue|relay op`: 0 hits; control grep `fleet-write|relay` on the same set: 2 hits.
- Semantic search "fleet-write relay op to add sub-issue link to epic parent", state all: 2 hits, #21915 and #19884, both other ops.
